metadata.scope: ANSI and DIN pipe flanges, blind flanges, weld-neck flanges, hose barbs, pipe elbows.

material_suggestions.use_case: welded pipe flanges in general service
material_suggestions.notes: Most common flange material; coat for corrosion protection.

material_suggestions.use_case: chemical, food, and marine pipe flanges

material_suggestions.notes: Print at 100% infill with ≥4 perimeters for water-tight walls.

standards_used.name: ASME B16.5
standards_used.applies_to: ANSI flange bolt circle, OD, and thickness by pressure class
standards_used.note: Class 150 NPS 2": OD 152 mm, bolt_circle 121 mm, 4×ø19 mm, thickness 19 mm.

standards_used.name: DIN 2573 / EN 1092-1 PN16
standards_used.note: DN50 PN16: OD 165 mm, bolt_circle 125 mm, 4×ø18 mm, thickness 20 mm.

standards_used.name: ASME B16.5 bolt offsetting
standards_used.note: Offset by 22.5° from vertical so bolts do not land on centreline top/bottom.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Blind flange DN50 PN16

fit_guidance_mm.bolt_holes: ø18 mm clearance holes for M16 studs

main_features: bolt circle holes repeated using for-loop
design_rules: bolt holes placed using cos()/sin() on bolt_circle_d
offset bolt pattern by 22.5° so bolts not on vertical centre
raised face is smaller-diameter boss on front face
validation_criteria: bolt holes use for-loop with cos/sin placement
no central bore for blind flange
failure_modes: bolt holes at fixed positions not parametric
bolt holes on vertical centreline instead of offset

constraint_checks.expression: for-loop with cos/sin for bolt holes
constraint_checks.message: Flange bolt holes must use parametric cos/sin placement on bolt circle.
